uv writes the exact version of each package in a file, the lockfile `uv.lock`. A recipe that runs `uv` can
change the lockfile, and uv prints no warning. This section changes no recipe. It sets one variable,
`UV_LOCKED`, which each recipe gives to `uv`. With it, uv stops with an error when it would have to change the
lockfile.

## 4.10 Recipes refuse an old lockfile {#step-04.10}

When `pyproject.toml` changes and the lockfile does not, `uv run` writes a new lockfile and prints no warning. So
any recipe can change the lockfile, and the person who runs it does not see the change. The variable `UV_LOCKED`
makes every `uv run` refuse a lockfile that is out of date. The `justfile` exports it to every recipe.

[± See the change to `justfile`](#step-04.10-justfile-424f0b-diff){.btn .btn-sm .btn-secondary}

Near the top of the `justfile`, `export UV_LOCKED := "1"` is on line 6, under `set positional-arguments`.

```bash
just --evaluate UV_LOCKED
```

It prints `1`. `just` puts the variable in the environment of every command of every recipe, so each `uv run`
sees it.

### What changed {#step-04.10-what-changed-182c57}

- <a id="step-04.10-justfile-424f0b"></a>`justfile`: one line, which exports `UV_LOCKED` to every recipe. 2 lines added. [The file](https://github.com/rahuldave/smallwikiapp/blob/b7469ee81a824a46e6799d60957ea09d7cf2eade/justfile){.btn .btn-sm .btn-secondary}
  - look at `export UV_LOCKED := "1"`

<a id="step-04.10-justfile-424f0b-diff"></a>

<details><summary>The diff of <code>justfile</code></summary>

```diff
@@ -3,6 +3,8 @@
 # Each word after a recipe's name reaches its commands whole, as "$1", "$2" and so on; "$@" is all of them
 set positional-arguments
 
+export UV_LOCKED := "1"
+
 [private]
 default:
     @just --list --unsorted
```

</details>
